svg.title: Life lost and victory
svg.desc: Two scenes from the game. On the left, the life-lost screen: the hero, without his helmet, cries ice cubes. On the right, the victory screen: four snowmen in woolly hats, arms raised, toss the hero into the air amid bunting, confetti, fireworks, an igloo and an icesheep.

g.text: Life lost: back to base, half your N₂ gone
